senses.en: King of England and Ireland from 1547 to 1553; son of Henry VIII and Jane Seymour; died of tuberculosis (1537-1553)

senses.en: King of England who was crowned at the age of 13 on the death of his father Edward IV but was immediately confined to the Tower of London where he and his younger brother were murdered (1470-1483)
senses.zh: 英格兰国王,13岁时因父亲爱德华四世去世而加冕,但立即被限制在伦敦塔内,他和弟弟在那里被谋杀(1470年-1483年).

senses.en: King of England from 1461 to 1470 and from 1471 to 1483; was dethroned in 1470 but regained the throne in 1471 by his victory at the battle of Tewkesbury (1442-1483)
senses.zh: 1461年到1470年和1471年到1483年分别是英格兰国王;1470年被废黜,但在1471年因在特沃克斯伯里战役(1442年-1483年)的胜利而重新夺回王位.

senses.en: son of Edward II and King of England from 1327-1377; his claim to the French throne provoked the Hundred Years' War; his reign was marked by an epidemic of the Black Plague and by the emergence of the House of Commons as the powerful arm of British Parliament (1312-1377)
senses.zh: 1327-1377年爱德华二世与英格兰国王之子;他对法国王位的主张引发了百年战争;他的统治标志是黑瘟疫的流行,下议院的出现成为英国议会的强大臂膀(1312-1377年).

senses.en: King of England from 1307 to 1327 and son of Edward I; was defeated at Bannockburn by the Scots led by Robert the Bruce; was deposed and died in prison (1284-1327)
senses.zh: 1307年至1327年任英格兰国王,爱德华一世之子;在班诺克本被布鲁斯人罗伯特率领的苏格兰人击败;被废黜,死于狱中(1284年-1327年).

senses.en: King of England from 1272 to 1307; conquered Wales (1239-1307)
senses.zh: 1272年至1307年任英格兰国王;征服威尔士(1239年至1307年).
